mindtraced_atomic_units: The Lemmings' behavior is modeled using a finite state machine.
Lemmings can be in one of two states: walking left (walk_left is 1) or walking right (walk_right is 1).
Lemmings cannot walk in both directions simultaneously.
Lemmings must always be walking in one direction or the other.
If a Lemming is bumped on the left (bump_left = 1), it will walk right.
If a Lemming is bumped on the right (bump_right = 1), it will walk left.
If bumped on both sides, the Lemming will switch direction.
When ground=0, the Lemming will fall and assert the 'aaah' signal (aaah=1).
When ground=1, the 'aaah' signal is deasserted (aaah=0), and the Lemming resumes walking in the same direction as before the fall.
Bumping the Lemming while falling has no effect on the walking direction.
Bumping the Lemming in the same cycle as ground disappears also does not affect the walking direction.
Bumping the Lemming when the ground reappears while still falling also does not affect the walking direction.
areset is a positive edge-triggered asynchronous reset.
When areset transitions from 0 to 1, the Lemming machine resets to the walking left state (walk_left=1, walk_right=0).
When areset transitions from 0 to 1, the 'aaah' signal is deasserted (aaah=0).
The design should be implemented as a Moore state machine.
Input: clk
Input: areset
Input: bump_left
Input: bump_right
Input: ground
Output: walk_left
Output: walk_right
Output: aaah
spec_atomic_units: Module top_module has inputs clk, areset, bump_left, bump_right, and ground.
Module top_module has outputs walk_left, walk_right, and aaah.
The outputs walk_left, walk_right, and aaah are Moore-type outputs.
walk_left = (current_state == LEFT) & ground;
walk_right = (current_state == RIGHT) & ground;
aaah = (current_state == FALLING);
State Encoding: LEFT = 2'b00
State Encoding: RIGHT = 2'b01
State Encoding: FALLING = 2'b10
If current_state is LEFT and !ground, then next_state = FALLING
If current_state is LEFT and bump_left || bump_right, then next_state = RIGHT
If current_state is LEFT, then next_state = LEFT otherwise
If current_state is RIGHT and !ground, then next_state = FALLING
If current_state is RIGHT and bump_left || bump_right, then next_state = LEFT
If current_state is RIGHT, then next_state = RIGHT otherwise
If current_state is FALLING and ground, then next_state = previous_state
If current_state is FALLING and !ground, then next_state = FALLING
If bump_left and bump_right are asserted simultaneously while walking, the Lemming switches direction.
When ground is 0, the Lemming transitions to the FALLING state.
When ground becomes 1 again, the Lemming resumes walking in the same direction as before the fall.
The previous walking direction must be stored before transitioning to the FALLING state.
The design adheres to the Moore machine paradigm.
The logic is designed to be synchronous, with state transitions occurring on the rising edge of the clock signal.
areset is a positive edge-triggered asynchronous reset.
When areset transitions from 0 to 1, the state machine resets to the walk_left state.
State transitions and output changes occur on the positive edge of the clk signal, except for the asynchronous reset.
